verdict.rationale: Floot's docs say users can read and export the code of their own generated apps, but that is the user's project code, not Floot's own source. Nothing in the pack shows Floot's platform source being published under any open license. Open-sourcing is a fair question for a SaaS app builder, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
